name: Irene the Witch
original_name: アイリーン・ザ・ウィッチ
source:
A very stoic and silent "witch". She fights only in order to survive. Like Edna, she is very neutral and doesn't want to be on anyone's side.

[spoiler]She joins the witch hunters and becomes an obstacle to Shougo's group.[/spoiler]
translation:
